prompt:
Workflow step: Use the mobile robot arm to move the two silicone container from material station to mobile robot platform.
Inspection timing: before this step
Inspection location: material station
What the inspection checks: Check whether two silicone containers are placed on material station in the following order: a green-marked silicone container on the left, immediately followed by a blue-marked silicone container.

A description of the inspection camera's photograph follows, written by someone who was not told what is being checked.

Description: A laboratory bench with aluminium rails holding labelled positions marked by white/purple labels and black-and-white square barcode tags. On the left, black plastic racks hold upright conical tubes with orange screw caps, all closed; several contain clear or slightly cloudy liquid, others appear empty. Along the rails at centre and right stand three white plastic squeeze/dropper bottles, upright and capped with red conical nozzle caps; their collars are green, blue and red respectively. Nearby are two low white round-domed vessels seated in rail positions, plus a smaller white cap-like piece at right. In the background sit clear plastic pipette-tip racks and stacked white trays on a shelf against a pale wall.
observations: The description shows three squeeze/dropper bottles with green, blue and red collars standing along the rails, rather than exactly two containers with green then blue markings; the presence of the extra red-collared container means the specified arrangement (green immediately followed by blue, only two containers) is not what is staged.
